recipe_navigation.validation_probe: Test one passing row among failures, all failures, multiple periods, and missing indicators.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Invented schema
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which catalog or supplied schema proves each table and column exists?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Inspect qualified objects and column types; keep unknown mappings explicit.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Wrong row grain
failure_mode_navigation.question: What is one input row and one output row supposed to represent?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Write both grains; aggregate or deduplicate by entity identity at the appropriate stage.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Missing relationship key
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which complete columns identify the relationship, and which side is unique?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Inspect declared keys and run duplicate-key checks before joining.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Unintended many-to-many match
failure_mode_navigation.question: How many matches can each input row find on the opposite side?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Bring inputs to compatible grains or model the intended many-to-many relationship explicitly.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Unbounded Cartesian product
failure_mode_navigation.question: Is every combination intentional, and what bounds it?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Supply the missing predicate or explicitly limit the generated domain.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Outer-join preservation defeated
failure_mode_navigation.question: Should this condition restrict matching children or reject entire parent rows?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Place the condition at the stage matching its intent; do not mechanically relocate every filter.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Aggregate inflated by join multiplicity
failure_mode_navigation.question: At what grain was each measure recorded?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Aggregate each measure at its natural grain before combining compatible summaries.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Wrong count population
failure_mode_navigation.question: Are we counting rows, matched children, or observed values?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Choose the count expression matching the intended population.

failure_mode_navigation.name: NULL treated as ordinary equality
failure_mode_navigation.question: Is missingness itself the condition being tested?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Use explicit missingness predicates and decide NULL semantics before comparison.

failure_mode_navigation.name: NOT IN exclusion contaminated by NULL
failure_mode_navigation.question: Can the exclusion expression or outer candidate be NULL?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Use a deliberately correlated absence test or a justified NULL-filtered exclusion set.

failure_mode_navigation.name: DISTINCT masks the wrong relationship
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which entity is duplicated, and which identifier distinguishes it?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Fix relationship or survivor logic before considering projection deduplication.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Tied ordering is under-specified
failure_mode_navigation.question: What tie-breaker is meaningful and unique for this task?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Specify the intended tie policy and use verified identity when a unique order is required.

failure_mode_navigation.name: A row cap is mistaken for a top-N rule
failure_mode_navigation.question: Is any sample acceptable, or must the selected rows be the first under a defined ordering?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Use the source’s arbitrary cap only for arbitrary selection; order before selecting a ranked result.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Implicit frame changes the question
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which rows belong in the frame for this exact current row?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Write the intended frame explicitly after checking dialect and data type support.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Running total lacks a defined sequence
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which event order and partition boundary define accumulation?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Declare ordering and reset keys independently of presentation order.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Period boundaries include or exclude the wrong rows
failure_mode_navigation.question: Does each interval include its start and end, and are values dates or timestamps?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Specify boundary semantics before choosing date expressions.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Calendar week mistaken for fiscal or operational week
failure_mode_navigation.question: What exact week start, week-year, and fiscal mapping does the report require?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Use an approved calendar mapping rather than guessing from a function name.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Timestamp zone or business-day cutoff omitted
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which zone and business-day cutoff assign an event to a reporting day?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Obtain the timestamp and reporting-calendar definitions; the book does not supply them.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Parser assumes a cleaner format than the data has
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which delimiters, escaping rules, and missing-token cases are allowed?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Define a parser contract and quarantine cases it does not establish.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Pattern matching admits unintended strings
failure_mode_navigation.question: Is the task finding a substring or validating the entire candidate value?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Specify candidate boundaries and the exact allowed pattern under the target dialect.

failure_mode_navigation.name: A source variant is used in another dialect
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which database version must run this query?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Translate the conceptual operation, then verify syntax and semantics separately.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Pivot silently omits expected categories
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which categories must appear even when no observation exists?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Establish the category domain and missing-versus-zero policy before pivoting.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Bucket edges or bucket meaning are ambiguous
failure_mode_navigation.question: What quantity defines bucket width, and which side owns an endpoint?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Define bucket units, endpoints, and remainder policy explicitly.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Subtotal rows are counted as detail
failure_mode_navigation.question: How can the consumer identify the aggregation level of each row?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Retain grouping-level metadata and separate detail from subtotal consumption.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Generated statement text is executed without review
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which values are parameters, which are identifiers, and who authorized execution?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Keep generation separate from execution; validate identifiers and use target-supported safe binding.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Recursive expansion is not safely bounded
failure_mode_navigation.question: What decreases or advances each step, and how are cycles handled?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Verify anchor, recursive names, progress, cycle policy, and a finite bound.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Historical support is presented as current
failure_mode_navigation.question: What official documentation and local result establish this version’s behavior?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Carry current-verification flags and record evidence before declaring current compatibility.

failure_mode_navigation.name: The query invents a metric definition
failure_mode_navigation.question: Who defined the population, amount, exclusions, and denominator?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Leave business definitions as unresolved inputs until authoritative evidence is provided.

failure_mode_navigation.name: A SQL association is presented as a causal effect
failure_mode_navigation.question: What evidence beyond these query outputs supports the causal claim?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Report descriptive association and its limitations; do not infer causation from the SQL alone.

failure_mode_navigation.name: A source listing contradicts its stated method
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which source statement, expression, and expected result conflict?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Keep the issue visible, block unreviewed code reuse, and label any proposed repair separately.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Unreviewed destructive or broad data change
failure_mode_navigation.question: Which exact identifiers should change, and what approved recovery process exists?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Require a read-only affected-row preview, authorized write scope, and environment-appropriate recovery review.

failure_mode_navigation.name: Percentage uses an unclear or empty denominator
failure_mode_navigation.question: Exactly which rows and values contribute to the denominator?
failure_mode_navigation.mitigation: Compute numerator and denominator at compatible grains and define empty-denominator behavior.

decision_navigation.check: Check match counts and the need for right-side output columns.

decision_navigation.default: Choose a membership expression matching the required correlation and NULL treatment; do not claim one is always faster.
decision_navigation.check: Test duplicates and NULLs and inspect a live plan before performance claims.

decision_navigation.default: Prefer an explicit absence test when a nullable exclusion set would make NOT IN unsafe.
decision_navigation.check: Add a NULL exclusion value and check unmatched candidates.

decision_navigation.default: Use grouping to reduce rows; use a window when detail rows must carry aggregate context.
decision_navigation.check: Compare input and output entity counts and verify each partition.

decision_navigation.default: Decide whether the consumer needs records to inspect or a measure at a summarized grain.
decision_navigation.check: Check functional identity and reconcile summary totals to detail.

decision_navigation.default: Choose the form that makes stage boundaries and column visibility easiest to review; neither is an automatic optimization.
decision_navigation.check: Validate stage output and measure actual execution before asserting speed.

decision_navigation.choice: Recursive CTE versus an existing hierarchy relation
decision_navigation.default: Use verified existing hierarchy data when it already answers the path question; recurse over adjacency only when needed.
decision_navigation.check: Check roots, path identity, cycles, and mapping freshness.

decision_navigation.default: Use CASE for a small stated classification; use a verified mapping relation when classifications are maintained as data.
decision_navigation.check: Test branch boundaries and mapping-key uniqueness.

decision_navigation.choice: DISTINCT versus fixing data or joins
decision_navigation.default: Explain duplicates by entity and relationship before removing projected values.
decision_navigation.check: Test legitimate equal-valued entities and reconcile event identities.

decision_navigation.default: Choose the reshape layer using the required output contract and verified consumer capabilities, not the book alone.
decision_navigation.check: Reconcile long and wide totals, absent categories, and downstream field stability.

decision_navigation.choice: Date range versus extracted date parts
decision_navigation.default: Use explicit interval boundaries for period membership; use components when the question genuinely compares components.
decision_navigation.check: Test exact endpoints and year changes; check plans before performance conclusions.

decision_navigation.choice: Generated sequence versus existing date dimension
decision_navigation.default: Use an approved calendar relation when business periods are required; otherwise generate the required bounded date domain.
decision_navigation.check: Count required days and verify leap days, gaps, and calendar keys.

decision_navigation.default: Keep a simple, specified parser close to the query only when it can be tested; otherwise expose unresolved format handling to an upstream process.
Prefer a verified built-in operation that implements the required semantics; retain a custom pattern when the source operation or target constraints require it.
decision_navigation.check: Check odd/even medians, empty inputs, and datatype boundaries.

decision_navigation.default: Separate the conceptual transformation from vendor syntax; prefer clarity within the actual deployment constraints.
decision_navigation.check: Apply one expected-output fixture across every required target.

decision_navigation.default: Expose important grain-changing stages so each can be checked independently.
decision_navigation.check: Check row counts, keys, and totals at every grain transition.

decision_navigation.default: Require schema evidence before claiming executable query text.
decision_navigation.check: Resolve schema-qualified names, types, key columns, and permissions.

decision_navigation.default: Treat population, exclusions, and denominator rules as explicit business inputs to the query.
decision_navigation.check: Reconcile a signed-off example population and period.

decision_navigation.default: Establish expected output and counterexamples before tuning runtime.
decision_navigation.check: Preserve result equivalence when testing an optimization.

source_issue_navigation.description: Deduplicating salaries by value cannot preserve two different employees with the same salary. The discussion also describes aggregation before the join.
source_issue_navigation.action: Prefer the source-supported preaggregation alternative when salary values repeat; verify entity identity.

source_issue_navigation.description: The dialect heading includes MySQL while the body describes a UNION workaround rather than direct FULL OUTER JOIN.
source_issue_navigation.action: Treat heading coverage and runnable variant coverage separately.

source_issue_navigation.description: The broad MERGE applicability statement does not establish a verified per-version syntax and branch contract.
source_issue_navigation.action: Review every target version and branch; do not import the source listing unchanged.

source_issue_navigation.description: An unqualified empty-string/NULL equivalence statement is not scoped as a portable five-dialect rule.
source_issue_navigation.action: Test empty string and NULL separately for the target database.

source_issue_navigation.description: Function names and argument/order syntax vary inconsistently between the prose and displayed dialect variants.
source_issue_navigation.action: Retain the ordered concatenation idea; verify the complete function syntax independently.

source_issue_navigation.description: Some displayed variants group by character rather than the original string identity while reconstructing the string.
source_issue_navigation.action: Verify grouping identity and repeated characters before using a variant.

source_issue_navigation.description: The SQL Server splitting/aggregation example does not establish a stable original-row and token-ordinal contract.
source_issue_navigation.action: Require a row identity and token position; do not assume nth-element semantics.

source_issue_navigation.description: Adding one to a zero value before logarithmic multiplication changes the requested product.
source_issue_navigation.action: Keep the positivity precondition or design and validate an explicitly different zero/sign policy.

source_issue_navigation.description: The prose mentions extra weight for recent observations, but the displayed three-term average uses equal weights.
source_issue_navigation.action: Label the displayed operation a simple three-observation average; do not silently supply weighted coefficients.

source_issue_navigation.description: The MySQL CUME_DIST selection combines the ranks on both sides of 0.5 and can average the whole distinct rank/value population instead of central values.
source_issue_navigation.action: Block unreviewed reuse of the listing; test odd/even counts and tied values against an explicit median.

source_issue_navigation.description: The final displayed deviation ratio centers on MAD rather than the median, contradicting the preceding method description. Some variants inherit the median-selection issue.
source_issue_navigation.action: Preserve the method described in prose; require an independently validated implementation and MAD=0 policy.

source_issue_navigation.description: Counting all joined rows after completing first-digit categories can count a NULL-extended missing category as one observation.
source_issue_navigation.action: Count observed matches, not category placeholder rows; test absent digit categories.

source_issue_navigation.description: Example dates and expected outputs use multiple historical year ranges and contain inconsistent year labels.
source_issue_navigation.action: Keep fixtures recipe-local; do not merge outputs into one authoritative EMP dataset.

source_issue_navigation.description: The demonstrated bucket expression uses consecutive transaction positions; fixed elapsed-time interpretation relies on the stated regular sampling assumptions.
source_issue_navigation.action: For irregular timestamps, specify and test actual time boundaries rather than treating row buckets as time buckets.

source_issue_navigation.description: The discussion makes historical database support statements for grouping metadata and cube operations.
source_issue_navigation.action: Verify the actual database release instead of interpreting omissions as present-day lack of support.

source_issue_navigation.description: The Fibonacci example declares workingTable but references anchor in the recursive member.
source_issue_navigation.action: Resolve recursive names and validate the first terms and termination before execution.

source_issue_navigation.description: The prose makes a broad cross-vendor statement about the RECURSIVE keyword without a verified version-specific syntax matrix.
source_issue_navigation.action: Use the source for the recursion idea, not as current vendor syntax authority.

source_issue_navigation.description: The appendix’s grouping axioms describe nonempty explicit groups and positive row counts; an unqualified reading could misapply them to COUNT(nullable_column) or a scalar aggregate on an empty input.
source_issue_navigation.action: Keep the argument scoped to explicit grouping and row counts; cross-check recipes 7.4, 7.5, and 7.12.

load_policy: Use navigation cards to choose a small set of full records from their modules. Do not claim execution, current support, or business definitions from a card.
